content.short: Tetris style puzzle game on Cardano
content.description: Easy to play and fully on-chain puzzle game on Cardano. Mint some random puzzle pieces and fit them into the board by moving and rotating them. When the puzzle is complete, you can merge the pieces to mint a reward token.
